purpose: Give the Potato House one simple coordinate grammar capable of superposing planes, Rooms, routes, organisms, comparative structures and temporal development without flattening them into one tradition.
global_rule: Every navigable state can be described by four questions: how high/deep, how inward/outward, which subject direction, and how its state changes through recurrence.

coordinates.label: Up / Down
coordinates.question: Which plane or depth am I in?
coordinates.negative: down / Below-facing roots, burial, residue and repair
coordinates.boundary: Vertical position is not moral worth or truth rank.

coordinates.label: Inside / Outside
coordinates.question: Is this relation moving toward integration/centered belonging or outward dispersion/capture?
coordinates.outward: outside / Wide Road / dispersion / external field
coordinates.boundary: Outside is not evil. Exteriority enables exchange, travel, plurality and return; Wide Road names unintegrated dispersion, not all outward movement.

coordinates.label: Around / Direction
coordinates.question: Which subject family or Room am I facing?
coordinates.rule: Direction changes topic/owner while preserving plane and radial state.
coordinates.boundary: Angular direction is classification/navigation, not cosmic hierarchy.

coordinates.label: Spiral / Recurrence
coordinates.question: What changed this cycle besides elapsed time?
coordinates.zero: ring/cycle with little net state change
coordinates.negative: descent/rooting/burial or degrading recurrence depending context
coordinates.boundary: Spiral direction requires named state variables; clockwise/counter-clockwise alone carries no universal moral meaning.

derived_structures.meaning: Keeps up/down relation stable while Rooms and local centers change.

derived_structures.definition: A sequence of guarded Doors ordered mainly along vertical change.
Continuous increase in integration/perspective toward an upper coordination point.
Rooted vertical organism whose branching introduces angular differentiation and whose Fruit returns as Seed.
derived_structures.meaning: Roots below, trunk through World, canopy/fruit above, with branches differentiating into Rooms/functions.

derived_structures.definition: Lower branching that acquires resources/provenance and carries memory/cause beneath visible structure.
derived_structures.meaning: Depth and distribution beneath visible life.

derived_structures.definition: Seed crosses a developmental threshold from buried/dormant potential into visible growth.
derived_structures.meaning: A Door event from Below toward World.

derived_structures.definition: A specialized directional extension from trunk/core.
derived_structures.meaning: New Room/function only when specialization earns distinct ownership.

derived_structures.definition: Multiple functions or practices arranged around a center, returning cyclically without requiring vertical displacement.
Wheel/ring recurrence plus measurable state displacement.
derived_structures.meaning: Repeated passage that changes level, integration or capability.

derived_structures.definition: A logarithmic/growth-spiral comparator in which scale changes continuously with angle; Fibonacci/golden-ratio constructions are special approximations/relationships, not the definition of all natural spirals.
derived_structures.meaning: Useful for visualizing proportional growth and self-similar scaling across turns.
derived_structures.boundary: Do not claim plants, galaxies, shells or the Potato House universally obey Fibonacci/golden-ratio geometry.

derived_structures.definition: Comparative reminder that coordinated change can be cyclical, relational and nonmoral rather than simple upward victory/downward failure.
derived_structures.meaning: Flow, complementarity and return can cross inward/outward and up/down without collapsing into a single moral axis.
derived_structures.boundary: Daoism remains its own philosophical/religious tradition; this is a bounded process comparison.

angels.rule: Angels/messengers usually project between Heaven-facing and World-facing zones because their source traditions assign celestial/messenger roles; texts, appearances and reception remain World-owned.
angels.boundary: Not every helpful person or upward symbol is an angel.

demons.rule: Demon/adversarial figures generally project between Below-facing and World-facing zones when their own traditions locate them in adversarial, underworld or harmful-spirit roles.
demons.boundary: Do not infer literal demonic identity for people, groups, subcultures or disliked religions.

spirits.rule: Tradition-specific spirits may inhabit upper, world or lower zones depending on their own source tradition; Spirit as Potatoverse relation is a crosscutting function rather than an inhabitant.

gods.rule: Divine figures usually project upper/world through theology, cult, text and institution; chthonic/death aspects may also project Below.

center_everywhere.formula: local center = governing question + active inputs + tests + available Doors + handoff/return
center_everywhere.rule: The center is repeated functionally at every meaningful Room/process junction. It is not a duplicated Potato. It is the local place where orientation and transition become actionable.
process_examples: Seed Bed center: Is this potential viable, dormant, damaged or ready to sprout?
Culture Square center: What norm/identity/information process is forming here and what are its correction/exit conditions?
Forge center: What evidence, responsibility and redesign are required to prevent recurrence?
Garden center: What conditions increase independent future capacity?
History Road center: What changed between occurrence, source, interpretation and current canon?
World Gate center: What state/capability changes if this Door is crossed?

simple_reader_model: 1. Stand somewhere: Heaven, World or Below.
2. Ask whether the movement is inward/integrating, boundary-crossing, or outward/dispersing.
4. Follow the relevant structure: Root, Tree, Road, Wheel, Ladder, Mountain, Spiral or Door.
5. At every junction, use the local center question and tests.
6. Evaluate Fruit and either return, revise, repair or reseed.
